description: Runs kova verify at session start when the kova CLI is installed. Install the CLI: curl -fsSL https://kovaverified.io/install.sh | sh

hooks.command: command -v kova >/dev/null 2>&1 && kova verify --hook claude-code || true
command -v kova >/dev/null 2>&1 && kova ledger record --harness claude-code || true
command -v kova >/dev/null 2>&1 && kova guard --harness claude-code || true
command -v kova >/dev/null 2>&1 && kova touched --harness claude-code || true
